recognize_zh: 中央四個小到中型淋巴球，細胞質少、深藍色，邊緣有明顯的細胞質突起（blebs），核形略不規則、染色質中度凝集，兩側有破碎的污斑細胞，符合 T 前淋巴球性白血病（T-PLL）。
features: Small-to-medium lymphoid cells with high N:C ratio
Scant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent cytoplasmic blebs/protrusions
Round to irregular nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous in these cells
Two smudge cells flanking the field
Background RBCs normocytic with occasional crenated forms
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a cluster of small-to-medium lymphoid cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round to slightly irregular nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin, and scant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with conspicuous cytoplasmic blebs. Nucleoli are not prominent in these particular cells (small-cell variant morphology). Two smudge cells are present. In the setting of marked lymphocytosis, findings are suggestive of T-prolymphocytic leukemia; confirmation by flow cytometry and TCL1A/MTCP1 rearrangement or TCL1 immunostaining is recommended.

ddx.vs: CLL cells have soccer-ball clumped chromatin and scant pale cytoplasm without blebs, and are CD5+/CD23+ B cells.
Sézary cells show cerebriform, deeply grooved nuclei rather than round nuclei with basophilic blebbed cytoplasm.
ATLL cells have polylobated 'flower' nuclei and are CD25+/HTLV-1 associated, TCL1-negative.

ddx.dx: B-prolymphocytic leukemia / splenic marginal zone lymphoma
ddx.vs: B-PLL cells have a single prominent central nucleolus, and SMZL cells show polar villi; both are B-lineage by flow.
